name: qfd_seq_su-sl2-09404756a
purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 contract v4b slot cell qfd_seq_su (1 instance seq_su, 518.376^2): first slot-shaped view under the die master name. Body = ot_qfd_seq_su_bi PSRAM 1 / HQ2 1 / RRG 1 / PCUT 1 at the TP8 setting D 8 / G 3,072 (qwen-tp8/seq f8aa5e43a, cherry-picked: 3-bit collective rank) (closed as qfd_seq_su_bi-febra-dace0dae3 at 518.4^2, M8 era); the wrapper is WIRING ONLY (generated from the packing table), every body port is an IS/OS = 1 pin flop. 2 x ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2 program store. Cut: 3,594 pin bits over 4 faces of 518 um (N 1,651 b on M5 = 0.31 of the 10,799 N-face M3/M5 tracks at 48 nm; the widest internal cut is the 1,024-b program word between the two SRAMs and the head FIFO, 1,024 b over ~4 x 518 um / 0.048 um x 0.5 usable = 0.05) <= 0.60. Clock: sinks per root measured by the --cts gate (gate_result.json).

structural_change: vs the 4 closed M8-era routes and 10 setup early-fails of ot_qfd_seq_su_bi (fea/feb/bi-fearl/bi-febra at 518.4^2, pins M4-M7, PG M6/M7): (1) NEW top = slot cell qfd_seq_su with the 33 contract bundles on the v3 faces (W su/sd/acc/cb, N vm + tt_ctlm, S d2d, E collective) instead of the old left/top/bottom/right pin regions; (2) layer cap M5 for signals and PG, pins M4 E/W + M5 N/S only (was M4/M6 + M5/M7); (3) rsi moves from an M8 area pin to an N-face pin flop; (4) kit recipe 2: hold margin 30 ps, macro halo 5.4 um, pin hold cells, every port flop FIRM at its pin (4 staggered rows); (5) body configuration = the last closed one (PSRAM 1, HQ2 1, RRG 1 replicated reset, PCUT 1 exact controller path cuts).
